# simply_registry_dnssec_keys (Resource)

Manages all DNSSEC keys registered for a Simply.com domain product.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "simply_registry_dnssec_keys" "example" {
  product = "example.com"

  keys = [
    {
      type = "ds"
      data = "12345 13 2 49fd46e6c4b45c55d4ac69c9c59cb3f3d2c3e91c10db85b2e3f1c12c4a0e3f1c"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `keys` (Attributes List) DNSSEC keys to publish at the registry. The Simply.com API removes all keys at once, so this resource manages the full set for the product. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))
- `product` (String) Simply.com product object, usually the domain name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource ID, equal to the product object.

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Required:

- `data` (String) Zone-file formatted record data. For DS: `keytag algorithm digestType digest`. For DNSKEY: `flags protocol algorithm pubkey`.
- `type` (String) DNSSEC record type. Must be `ds` or `dnskey`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import simply_registry_dnssec_keys.example example.com
```
